track: Warm prospects — broader re-engagement and response
track_strategy: This track reopens LUCI for the broader warm list through a fresh operating problem, visual proof, approved scale, and one focused invitation. It follows a different relationship stage from the selected preview, then hands every response to Mark and stops campaign language.
open_questions: Confirm the named LUCI lead used for WARM-REENGAGE-01 through 04; Marketing sends each email on that person's behalf.
Confirm the neutral trigger for opening the broader warm cycle.
Confirm the shorter follow-up selected-preview recipients receive instead of the full WARM-REENGAGE cycle.
Confirm [LUCI UPGRADE GUIDE URL], [FEATURE HIGHLIGHT REEL URL], [FULL RECORDING URL], [PROOF URL], [BOOKING URL], and [MARK EMAIL].
Approve each project-true count inserted for [APPROVED PROOF POINT] before WARM-REENGAGE-03 enters review.
Confirm that WARM-RESPONSE-01 sends from Marketing on Mark's behalf before Mark sends WARM-RESPONSE-02 personally.

emails.title: What changed
emails.timing: When Marketing opens the broader warm cycle
emails.sender: Marketing, from the same named LUCI lead
emails.audience: Broader warm contacts who did not receive the selected preview and remain outside active sales conversations
emails.primary_message: A cold reader sees the problem first: one wrong screen should not require several interfaces and an off-site expert.

strategy.what_why: A true reintroduction for the broader warm list, built around a familiar failure rather than selective access.
strategy.for_whom: Past contacts who may barely remember LUCI and did not receive the private-preview invitation.
strategy.reach: Open on one wrong screen after hours, define LUCI and the beta change, then make the guide the one primary action.
strategy.impact: Use a restaurant opening to reintroduce LUCI without repeating the campaign's wall-failure scenes.

directions.name: The dinner screen
directions.summary: The selected direction, revised for whole-campaign consistency.
directions.draft:
Dear #Name#,

Dinner service begins, but a restaurant TV still shows yesterday's brunch menu. The person who knows that control is not on property.

One stale screen should not start the shift's first phone tree.

LUCI orchestrates property A/V through one operating view. New LUCI is in beta, giving staff live screen checks, approved controls, and activity history. If they need help, the request reaches the LUCI team with device context and logs attached.

See the details in the LUCI Upgrade Guide: [LUCI UPGRADE GUIDE URL]

directions.name: One wrong wall
directions.summary: Use a visible failure to show why another look matters.
directions.draft:
Dear #Name#,

A wall that is not showing what it should creates a simple question: who can see the problem and act without starting a phone tree?

LUCI consolidates property A/V into one interface. New LUCI is in beta and adds direct screen checks, approved controls, and activity history for on-site staff, with our team still monitoring and supporting the platform.

The wall is complicated enough. The response should not be.

Read the LUCI Upgrade Guide: [LUCI UPGRADE GUIDE URL]

directions.name: Skip the interface hunt
directions.summary: Open on the cost of searching across systems and people.
directions.draft:
Dear #Name#,

When a screen goes wrong, the first job should be fixing it, not finding the right interface and the person who knows it.

LUCI gives the property one place to operate its A/V; New LUCI is in beta and gives staff more direct screen control, live status, and activity history while our team continues monitoring, diagnosis, and support.

No interface scavenger hunt required.

Review the LUCI Upgrade Guide: [LUCI UPGRADE GUIDE URL]

emails.why_won: It gives broader warm re-engagement its own property moment, assumes no product memory, and makes the support path concrete through attached context and logs.

emails.timing: Immediately after the reply, booking, or request

strategy.reach: Send immediately, make reply the primary action, and show the calendar only when the person has not booked.
strategy.impact: Use one plain reassurance: Mark has the handoff, and the prospect will not repeat anything already shared.
